description: FSMA K-shot synthesis on the paper-funnel cohort: paired adaptation deltas, the C2 controls (from_scratch / concat_retrain) and the C3 support-sampler ablation.  Primary test is a paired one-sided t; the bootstrap is reference-only because n is small.
significance_policy: paired one-sided t-test is primary; Holm-Bonferroni across the family; percentile bootstrap retained as *_reference_only

recovery_to_ceiling.note: recovery_to_ceiling[m] = mean k-shot query AUC / within-metal ceiling AUC, both on the paper-funnel cohort. >100% is possible when the LOMO source pool adds information the within-metal CV does not see.

cross_backbone_xgb.description: C5 cross-backbone check: the FSMA LOMO K-shot protocol run with Morgan-fingerprint + XGBoost, where adaptation = warm-started gradient boosting (xgb_model continuation) on the K support ligands.  Budget-matched controls from_scratch_k / concat_retrain_k separate adaptation from sample size.
